correctness.rationale: On μ(C_n), n>=4, each shadow spin minimizes a sum of three signs uniquely. Fix apex η, encode original spins in binary x_i; minimized energy is -2(B+T)J where B=#binary adjacent changes and T=Σx_i x_{i+2}. With k=#ones, C1=Σx_ix_{i+1}, D2=k-T, F=B+T=3k-2C1-D2. For even n, maximum F=3n/2 attained only by 2 alternating words; for odd n>=5, D2>=1 for nonconstant words and C1>=2k-n give max 3(n-1)/2 with precisely n unique single-11-defect words. Each apex choice doubles counts, giving g=4 or 2n and energies -3nJ or -3(n-1)J. Independently enumerated all physical graphs for n=4..8 and checked full degeneracy/magnetization; finite corroboration only.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not alone prove the claimed all-parameter result; proof-specific bounds established in analytic argument.

evidence: The Mycielski construction is classical, while the published three-state Potts theorem counts q=3 coloring ground states with zero frustration on even cycles and one bond on odd cycles.
The present Ising theorem is q=2 and has nonzero frustration on both parity classes, so its energy and multiplicity cannot be obtained by q=3 substitution.
